name: Guard Captain
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Guard Captain. AC 18 comes from the gear (Breastplate 14 + Dex 2 + Shield 2). Its Longsword (2d10 + 4) is a monster weapon (item.guard_captain_longsword), +6 from Strength and PB +2. Multiattack (two attacks) is effect.extra_attack. Its Javelins (3d6 + 4, thrown 30/120 ft.) are left out: core holds one melee weapon in the main hand and a thrown javelin would take the longsword's place. Athletics +6 and Perception +4 are proficiency. Its Initiative +4 (proficiency in Initiative) is not implemented: it rolls +2. Medium or Small: Medium here.
